risk_if_not_implemented: Without Off-Site Maintenance, maintenance activities may introduce unauthorized changes, expose systems to untrusted personnel or tools, or leave systems in an unsafe state. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Loss, Theft or Damage of Assets (R-AM-1), Loss of Confidentiality (R-IP-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to Physical Crime (MT-5), Human Error (MT-9), Transportation / Logistics Disruption (MT-26).

compensating_control_1.name: Remote Maintenance
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to authorize, monitor and control remote, non-local maintenance and diagnostic activities.
compensating_control_1.justification: Remote Maintenance (MNT-12) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Off-Site Maintenance (MNT-18) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Process applicability. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
compensating_control_2.description:
Automated mechanisms exist to enforce Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) for:
(1) Remote network access; 
(2) Third-party Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS); and/ or
(3) Non-console access to critical TAAS that store, transmit and/or process sensitive and/or regulated data.
compensating_control_2.justification: Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) (IAC-37) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of Off-Site Maintenance (MNT-18) by restricting system and data access to authorized users through alternative identity and access mechanisms. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
